# data.docker_config

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Looks up one swarm config (`GET /configs/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. `inspect.spec.data` is the content, base64-encoded as the Engine returns it.
